risks.risk: Actual size/length may be less than claimed (affects category and buyer value).
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape laid along the longest side (or a clear reference like a standard 6ft/3ft board) plus overall width and height.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a smaller-than-claimed upholstered sofa/seat (worst-case within what’s visible).

risks.risk: Foam firmness and sagging may be worse than claimed (affects comfort and resale).
risks.proof: Video clip showing the seller pressing down firmly in multiple spots and releasing to show rebound (front seat, backrest, and edges).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly slightly sagging/used (worst-case for comfort) rather than 'firm'.

risks.risk: Hidden stains/odor (including smoke smell) not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seams/underside and a quick smell/odor check video (seller opens/tilts to show underside and cushions).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if odor/stains could exist (worst-case) until proven otherwise.

risks.risk: Structural issues (loose frame, broken springs) not visible.
risks.proof: Video of sitting/rocking gently from different angles to show stability; also underside/frame photo if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as if structure may need inspection/repair (worst-case).

risks.risk: Brand/model may be different from what buyers expect; identity affects comparable pricing.
risks.proof: Photo of any label/tag on the underside/back and a wider shot showing the full set and any branding.
risks.if_unproven: Priced generically as an upholstered sofa/seat without brand premium.

proof_requests: A measuring-tape photo for total length (and width/height) to confirm 'over 4 feet'.
Video pressing test to confirm foam firmness and rebound.
Close-up photos of all seams, corners, and underside (to check hidden stains/tears).
A wider shot showing the full sofa/seat (front, side, and back) and any visible tags/labels.
response.reason: The photo shows an upholstered sofa/seat in generally good visible condition, but key pricing drivers (exact size, foam firmness, hidden stains/odor, and any identifying tag/brand) cannot be confirmed from this single angle. Missing these means a reliable worst-case price can’t be set confidently.
